changes.anchor: manual.md is the sole source of truth for fee/rule mechanics
changes.what: New rule: if a question references a mechanism (e.g. a 'fine') that manual.md never defines, answer Not Applicable rather than inferring it from an adjacent concept.
changes.why: Task 70: agent treated the monthly_fraud_level fee bracket as evidence of a 'high-fraud rate fine'; diagnosis states manual.md never defines any fine/penalty tied to fraud rate, confirmed by grepping manual.md for fine|penalt (only an unrelated PCI-DSS penalty in section 7.4 exists), and gold answer is Not Applicable.

changes.anchor: "Fraud" is a RATE: manual.md defines it as fraudulent volume
changes.what: New rule: 'fraud' means the volume-ratio rate defined in manual.md, not a raw count, and ranking 'by fraud' should use helper.fraud_rate_by.
changes.why: Task 49: agent ranked ip_country by raw fraud count (NL=2955) and answered NL, but by rate BE is highest (12.27% vs NL 12.18%); diagnosis root_cause cites manual.md section 7's rate definition, verified via fraud_rate_by giving BE 0.1227, matching gold 'B. BE'.

changes.anchor: Fee-rule fields (fees.json) use null/[] as "matches everything"
changes.what: New rule: null/[] wildcard semantics in fees.json apply to every field including scalar fields like is_credit and card_scheme, not just list-typed ones; also clarifies intracountry uses issuing_country vs acquirer_country, never ip_country.
changes.why: Task 1273: agent excluded 21 GlobalCard rules with is_credit: null, computing 0.117667 instead of gold 0.120132; diagnosis root_cause states null-as-wildcard applies to is_credit too, verified via average_fee_across_rules giving exact 0.120132 with 144 matching rules. The intracountry/ip_country clarification matches the helper.py is_intracountry docstring's warning not to substitute ip_country (manual.md section 5), though no specific task diagnosis cites an ip_country mix-up directly — not stated in the transcript beyond the helper docstring's own explanation.

changes.anchor: Never hand-loop over 1000 fee rules x N transactions
changes.what: New rule: don't hand-loop over fee rules/transactions across many tool calls; use the helper module's fee-matching functions and prefer one vectorised/helper-backed execute_python call.
changes.why: Task 1681: agent ran out of context/turns building an ad hoc matcher by hand across many tool calls, ending with a hardcoded acquirer_country and missing 2 of 10 gold fee IDs; diagnosis root_cause states no reusable fee-matching helper existed so the agent reinvented matching from scratch, burning turns.

changes.anchor: v0 was deliberately thin: loaders and the one formula the manual states
changes.what: Rewrote the module docstring to explain v1 adds computational primitives (fee-rule matching wildcard semantics, monthly bucketing, capture_delay mapping, intracountry flag) that the dev-split failures showed the agent reinventing incorrectly, and that all functions are parameterized to generalize across permutations.
changes.why: Directly summarizes the diagnosis.json's helper_diff_summary and prompt_diff_summary, and the optimiser's stated intent that these functions generalize across merchants/months/fee ids per the summary note under diagnosis for task 1681/1753.

changes.what: Added the datetime import needed for day_of_year_to_month.
changes.why: Supports the new monthly bucketing helpers required for tasks 1681/1753 (natural-month conversion from payments.csv's day_of_year/year columns). Not separately justified in the transcript beyond being a dependency — not stated in the transcript.

changes.what: Added fraud_rate(df): fraction of eur_amount volume that is fraudulent, per manual.md section 7's rate definition.
changes.why: Task 49: needed to compute fraud as fraudulent volume / total volume instead of a count; diagnosis 'change' field explicitly adds this to fix ranking by count vs rate, verified BE=0.1227 matches gold.

changes.anchor: def fraud_rate_by(df: pd.DataFrame, group_col: str) -> pd.Series:
changes.what: Added fraud_rate_by(df, group_col): fraud rate per group value, sorted descending, to replace value_counts()-based 'top fraud' ranking.
changes.why: Task 49: diagnosis 'change' field states 'Added helper.fraud_rate_by(df, group_col)'; verification command computed helper.fraud_rate_by(load_payments(), 'ip_country') giving BE as top, matching gold 'B. BE'.

changes.anchor: def day_of_year_to_month(day_of_year: int, year: int) -> int:
changes.what: Added day_of_year_to_month: converts payments.csv's (year, day_of_year) into a calendar month.
changes.why: Needed by monthly_merchant_stats to compute natural-month aggregates for tasks 1681/1753; not individually verified by a standalone command in the transcript but is a direct dependency of monthly_merchant_stats, which was verified — the specific conversion logic itself is not separately stated in the transcript.

changes.what: Added capture_delay_bucket: maps merchant_data.json's capture_delay values ('immediate', 'manual', day counts) onto fees.json's bucket strings ('<3','3-5','>5').
changes.why: Task 1681 diagnosis root_cause cites 'incomplete/inconsistent implementation (missing merchant-level monthly_fraud_level/monthly_volume bucketing...)' as the cause of the ad hoc matcher's failure; this bucketing function is part of applicable_fee_ids's merchant-level filter pipeline, verified end-to-end via the exact 10/10 fee-ID match for task 1681.

changes.what: Added fraud_level_bucket: maps a fraud-rate percentage onto fees.json's monthly_fraud_level bucket strings.
changes.why: Task 1753: agent computed fraud rate as a count ratio (8.38%) instead of manual's volume ratio, landing in the wrong bucket; this function (used inside monthly_merchant_stats) implements the correct bucket boundaries, verified via applicable_fee_ids producing the exact 34-id gold match.

changes.what: Added volume_bucket: maps a monthly EUR volume onto fees.json's monthly_volume bucket strings.
changes.why: Part of the same monthly_merchant_stats pipeline verified for tasks 1681 and 1753 (merchant-level monthly_volume filter for applicable_fee_ids); not separately called out on its own in the transcript beyond being a dependency.

changes.anchor: def monthly_merchant_stats(payments: pd.DataFrame, merchant: str, year: int, month: int)
changes.what: Added monthly_merchant_stats: computes a merchant's natural-month transactions, total volume, fraud rate, and the corresponding fees.json bucket strings in one call.
changes.why: Task 1753 diagnosis 'change': 'monthly_merchant_stats computes fraud_rate_pct via helper.fraud_rate (volume ratio) exclusively'; verified via applicable_fee_ids for Belles_cookbook_store March 2023 giving fraud rate 10.25% (bucket '>8.3%') and exact match to the gold 34-fee-ID list. Also underlies task 1681's exact 10/10 ID match.

changes.anchor: def is_intracountry(issuing_country: str, acquirer_country: str) -> bool:
changes.what: Added is_intracountry: compares issuing_country to acquirer_country per manual.md section 5, explicitly warning not to substitute ip_country.
changes.why: Corresponds to the system.md ground rule about intracountry using issuing/acquirer country rather than ip_country; used inside applicable_fee_ids, which was verified for task 1681 (exact 10/10 match) — no diagnosis entry cites a specific ip_country mix-up task, so the precise triggering failure is not stated in the transcript.

changes.what: Added _field_matches: uniform matching logic where None/actual-None/empty-list all mean 'matches everything', otherwise exact or list-membership match.
changes.why: Task 1273 root_cause: 'manual.md's null-as-wildcard rule applies to is_credit too... not just the list-typed fields'; this function implements that uniform semantics, verified by average_fee_across_rules producing 0.120132 (144 matching rules) exactly matching gold.

changes.what: Added fee_rule_matches: checks whether a fees.json rule applies given a set of optional merchant/transaction characteristics, using _field_matches for each of the nine fee-rule fields.
changes.why: Task 1273 diagnosis 'change': 'Added helper.fee_rule_matches/_field_matches with uniform null/[]-wildcard semantics across every field'; also the core building block verified for tasks 1681 and 1753's exact fee-ID matches.

changes.what: Added applicable_fee_ids: returns the fee IDs applying to a merchant over a period by combining merchant/period-level filters with each transaction row's card_scheme/is_credit/aci/intracountry.
changes.why: Task 1681 diagnosis 'change': 'Added ... applicable_fee_ids (per-row card_scheme/is_credit/aci/intracountry combined with merchant-level filters) so this is one helper call instead of ad hoc looping'; verified exact match to gold's 10 fee IDs for Belles_cookbook_store day_of_year=10, 2023, and separately verified exact 34-id match for task 1753.

changes.what: Added best_matching_fee: selects the single most-specific matching fee rule for one fully-specified transaction, tie-broken by lowest fee then lowest ID.
changes.why: Task 2697: with corrected matching semantics the helper agreed with gold on the ACI letter (E, 16.63 EUR) among A-F candidates for Belles_cookbook_store's January fraud transactions, though the exact EUR total (13.57) did not reproduce after multiple rule-selection variants; diagnosis explicitly states this was added as a general building block 'not tuned to this task's exact number' and the numeric gap is an acknowledged open issue, not fixed.

changes.anchor: def average_fee_across_rules(fees: list[dict[str, Any]], transaction_value: float, **filters: Any)
changes.what: Added average_fee_across_rules: averages the fee at a given transaction value across every fee rule matching the given filters, including wildcard (null) rules.
changes.why: Task 1273 diagnosis 'change': 'Added ... helper.average_fee_across_rules built on it'; verification command shows average_fee_across_rules(fees, 10, card_scheme='GlobalCard', is_credit=True) == 0.120132, exact match to gold.
